title: Free Move-In Rental Waiver Credit — Bluegate Moving Truck Rental
content:
**System reference — the free move-in rental waiver of the Bluegate Moving Truck Rental.**

## Rule

The free move-in rental waiver credits the first-day rental fee of the truck contract that carries the renter's storage-unit claim, as one free move-in waiver against that first-day fee line, and the environmental fee of a free move-in contract stays chargeable. The rental waiver is not credited before the truck contract carries the storage-unit claim it is credited for.

Stated the other way round: while the truck contract carries no storage-unit claim, no rental waiver is credited on it.

## What the posting does

`credit_move_in_rental_waiver_7c9a948d` posts one free move-in waiver credit for the amount given against the first-day rental fee line given, dated the day of the call, for the storage unit rental agreement named; the amount owed on the contract falls by that amount. The renter sees the rental waiver credit on the invoice.

## How it is invoked

It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `truck_rental_id` | The truck rental contract number the waiver is credited on, read from the truck rental lookup | Identifier |
| `linked_rental_id` | The storage unit rental agreement number the free move-in benefit belongs to, read from the storage unit rental lookup | Identifier |
| `reference_id` | The id of the first-day rental fee line being credited, read from the truck contract charge lookup | Identifier |
| `amount` | The rental waiver in USD | Positive amount rounded to 2 decimal places |

## Return

On success the tool returns `status` "credited", `truck_charge_id` (the id of the new credit line), `truck_rental_id`, `linked_rental_id` (the storage agreement the benefit belongs to), `credit_type` "free_move_in_waiver", `reference_id` (the credited first-day fee line), `amount` (USD with 2 decimal places) and `balance_due` (the amount now owed on the contract, USD with 2 decimal places). A status of "credited" means the waiver is recorded.
